projects.name: Starwood Plaza 500 South Data Center, Fairfax County
projects.description: 226,469 SF two-story data center shell filed at Plaza 500 near Alexandria. Phase 1 shell ~$5M; 34-acre site acquired 2022 for $165M.

sources.title: Starwood Fairfax data center, Commercial Observer

projects.open_for: Plans filed. Early shell and MEP specs.

projects.name: Dulles South Innovation Center (CPA denied), Prince William
projects.description: 43M SF AI/data center campus proposal on ~1,940 acres denied 8-0 by Prince William Board July 2026. Significant entitlement activity in-window.

sources.title: Dulles South data center denied, Data Center Knowledge

projects.open_for: Denied. Monitor alternate sites; entitlement signal for NoVA market.

projects.name: PowerHouse 95 North Data Center Campus, Spotsylvania County
projects.description: PowerHouse broke ground in July 2026 on its 145-acre, 800MW data center campus in Spotsylvania County. Up to eight 3-story buildings totaling 3.5M SF with three electrical substations.
key_specs: First substation completion Oct 2025 / live Oct 2026

sources.title: PowerHouse breaks ground on 800MW data center campus in Spotsylvania County, Virginia - DCD

projects.open_for: Under construction. Shell, substations, and MEP systems.

projects.name: CleanArc VA1 Hyperscale Data Center Campus, Caroline County
projects.description: CleanArc broke ground on a $3B, 900MW hyperscale data center campus in Caroline County, Virginia. Phase 1 (300MW) planned for 2027 using modular pre-engineered components and closed-loop cooling.

sources.title: Data center developer breaks ground on $3B Virginia campus - Yahoo/ENR

projects.open_for: Under construction. Modular MEP, power infrastructure, closed-loop cooling.

projects.name: Stack Infrastructure Berry Hill Megasite Campus
projects.description: Stack Infrastructure confirmed moving forward with a $73.5B (up to $100B) multi-decade data center campus on 2,990 acres at the Berry Hill Regional Megasite after state performance agreement cleared June 30, 2026.

sources.title: Governor Spanberger Delivers $73.5 Billion Data Center Investment - Harborwright

projects.open_for: Planning & site development. Massive long-term MEP and civil procurement.

projects.name: Amazon / Birchwood King George Data Center Park
projects.description: 7.5 million SF data center campus proposed in King George County with Amazon as the end user. Initial phases include up to eight buildings (4M SF) and substations. Recommended for approval June 2026.

sources.title: Virginia’s King George County looks to approve 7.5m sq ft data center park for Amazon - DCD

projects.open_for: Planning & zoning. Future MEP and shell specs.
